title: Phrasal verbs
desc: Verb + particle expressions from daily routines to business English.
intro: Phrasal verbs are verbs with a small word like up, off or out, and the meaning is often new. Study each list first, then practice with gaps, choices and corrections. Pay attention to where the object goes.
